question: What decides the _BSS order of file-scope statics (extends BSS-1)? Observed (worker rootE, module 1FD2, fitted on 14 randomized probes): ascending key = (sum of the UPPER-CASED identifier characters) mod 256, ties in reverse declaration order; declaration order otherwise has no effect. Positive control root:1FD2 (8CDC long, 8CE0 int, 8CE2 int reproduced as lastTick/shiftHeld/countdown); negative contrast: lastTime/pressed/delay put pressed first.
